plain: A model doing worse on a test than it could, on purpose or by habit, so it looks less capable than it is.
eli5: Pretending you can only run slowly in the race so nobody makes you carry the heavy bag.
technical: Strategic underperformance on an evaluation, by the model or its developer, so that measured capability sits below true capability; it breaks the assumption that a capability eval gives a lower bound you can push up with elicitation.
